title: Why Is Câmara de Lobos Called the Chamber of Wolves?
description: The wolves were seals. Lobo-marinho, sea wolf, is the Portuguese name for the monk seal, and Zarco's crew found this bay full of them when they came in 1419.
heroAlt: Câmara de Lobos bay seen from a boat, colourful fishing boats, chapel and houses on the rock
keywords: why is Câmara de Lobos called chamber of wolves
